notes.title: Rebalance update #2
notes.content:
We balanced the following dinosaurs

Ankylosaurus: enhanced injury reduction rate: the head injury reduction rate increased from 3 to 1.5, and the body injury reduction rate increased from 0.6 to 0.5

Triceratops: adult attack power increases by 200, HP increases by 10000, and old attack power increases by 200

Spinosaurus (bipedal): adult attack power increased by 400, HP increased by 10000, and elderly attack power increased by 200. Swimming speed ratio increased from 1.2 to 2.5

Spinosaurus (quadruped): adult attack power increased by 200, old attack power increased by 200, and swimming speed rate increased from 2 to 4.4

Sarcosuchus: adult attack power increases by 300 and HP increases by 4000. Elderly attack power plus 100 swimming speed rate increased from 1.2 to 2.2

Baryonyx: swimming speed ratio increased from 1.2 to 2.2

Brachiosaurus base bleeding speed lower limit increased from 0.5% per second to 0.05% per second

notes.title: The Beast of 9500 Major update released now !
notes.content:
Players! The Major update of beast 9500 has been released. This update includes the following contents:

● image quality optimization

--Now the beast 9500 uses HD pipeline, and the image quality has been improved by leaps and bounds

--The new rendering makes the underwater effect more realistic

--New light and shadow computing

● map reset

--Remake the map and improve the ground details subversively

--The ground is now rich in shrubs, which can be used as a cover for the raid

--A variety of aquatic plants are added to the seabed, making underwater life more real and colorful

● increased number of dinosaurs that can be played

--Ankylosaurus: a herbivorous dinosaur with high trunk defense, which can unlock the special attack of the second company's tail flick

--Kronosaurus: powerful marine reptile, which can unlock collision attack (long press the right mouse button to accumulate power), quickly approach and kill targets

● balance and experience overhaul

--For all playable dinosaurs, they will grow naturally after this update. Without adding points, they can slowly improve "attack power, blood volume, speed, endurance and other attributes" and grow up smoothly

--The battle data of all dinosaurs are rebalanced, and we will constantly adjust these data. Welcome to give us feedback

--The skill tree of all dinosaurs has been greatly changed. Most of the combat data bonus has been removed from the skill tree. Now you can strengthen the ability to find food and recover after the war in the skill tree interface, and unlock special skills. Don't worry, dinosaurs still have a high customization space!

--For the three dinosaurs, Ankylosaurus, Tyrannosaurus Rex and Kronosaurus, the shapes of young, adult and old will be very different, and we will slowly make the shape differences of all dinosaurs

● play method and operation update

--Aging mechanism: all dinosaurs can now continue to grow in adulthood and continue to improve their attributes until they reach old age

--The manipulation logic of all dinosaurs is rewritten. We have added details that are not limited to lens stretching, body tilt and other experience improvement. There will be no obvious uncontrol of all dinosaurs

--The actions and sounds of Tyrannosaurus Rex have been completely reset. Now the voice of adult Tyrannosaurus Rex will be very domineering and thick. You might as well listen!

--Grassland is now edible: for herbivores, they can eat when the camera is aimed at the green space, but the added nutritional value of each bite is only one fifth of that of fruit trees; Herbivorous dragons don't have to worry about starvation anymore!

--In order to match the survival of Marine reptiles, we have redone the operation mechanism of aquatic organisms. Now, when swimming forward, the mouse can dive 60 degrees down, and when underwater, the mouse can be used to control the direction.

--We have made adjustments to the picking of the body. We have used the doll system to move the body. Now it is more smooth and realistic

● other updates

--The "smell" function can now smell the water

--Some bug fixes

It has been a long time since our last update. We guarantee that the game will change greatly after this update. All people who have purchased our game are welcome to come back and play. We will continue to use the update to prove that we will not disappoint you!

● due to the time problem, we failed to deal with the following three points in time, and we will solve them as soon as possible

--Subsea tunnels and caves have not been added for the time being

--Thalassodromeus and ancient pterosaur are temporarily shielded, and we will readjust them

--Three kinds of AI have not been added: Chasmosaurus,  iguanodon and alamosaurus

The following is our update content and future update plan in half a month:

● - updated at the end of November

--Migration task system: herbivorous dinosaurs must follow the specified route and form groups to resist the enemy freely. They can obtain many items to increase skill points on the way, and more rewards will be given to herbivorous dinosaurs who complete to the end. At the same time, carnivorous dinosaurs can wait for the opportunity to hunt the marching herbivorous dinosaurs to obtain skill points

--Skill points exchange skin system: extra skill points can be exchanged for new skin

● - near term plan

--Custom skin system: players can create their own skin

--Young and old model replacement of Spinosaurus

--Nest system

--UI redo

The private server has been opened. You are welcome to open the server. We will help the server owners who want to open the server to deploy the server free of charge (for the server owners who do not have a server, we can assist the server owners to purchase the server, and the server cost needs to be paid by themselves)

notes.title: Update Announcement （Nov. 12th）
notes.content:
We are announcing Nov. 12th as the date of next major update for Beast of 9500.

Sorry for the slow progress caused by the shortage of funds and people. But still we managed to make some major optimazation in following parts:

● More flexible control experience: We recieved many complaints about dinosaurs being hard to control. So we improved our control by adding turning animation, changing the walking animation, remaking control logics and uderwater control systems. We will represent these featues for you in recent occasions.

● Skill tree remake: After adding the constant growth system, the previous skill tree and growth no longer suit the needs. Therefore we rewrote the skill and growth system, some perks were kept while the effects of other perks were put into the constant growth.

●  Terrain optimazation: We spent much time on the terrain optmazation, making this major update change little on the performance of computers, allowing everyone to play smoothly.

● Rebalance: We adjusted some data to rebalance the dinosaurs.

● Bug fixes: This update fixed some known bugs. However, there might be new bugs in the develop process. Please report to us if you meet any of these bugs.

Despite the lack of funding and our small team of just 4 , you have always been surpporting us, and we will deliver this update on time for you!

PS: This update will also bring back private servers. You could either use your own servers or contact us to rent servers. 

PPS: The private servers will not influence the players who want to create their own rooms. You can still create your own room and play with up to 16 players without any private servers.

Thank you for your patience, we are working around the clock to make this major update good and better!

● Skill tree remake: After adding the constant growth system, the previous skill tree and growth no longer suit the needs. Therefore we rewrote the skill and growth system, some perks were kept while the effects of other perks were put into the constant growth.

notes.title: Experience optimization update out now！
notes.content:
This update is an experience optimization update. We are still preparing for a big update, which will take several months.

The update includes the following contents:

1. Load optimization: now the load into the server will no longer be stuck, but it will take some time to enter for the first time, please wait patiently.

2. Improvement of weather system and image quality: we reset the weather system and optimize the anti aliasing treatment of the whole picture. Now the game scenery is more beautiful

3. The sensitivity of mouse wheel in server list area and dinosaur selection area is improved, and the experience of server selection is improved.

4. Some bug fixes that affect the experience: for example, when the level is increased, the health will be restored immediately.

In the big update, we will add a better new map and 2-3 new optional characters. As well as many unique mechanisms, the current development progress is slow, but we have a complete plan.

Thank you very much for your support and patience!

PS: we will restart the server configuration update in 7 hours, which will result in offline. We apologize for this

notes.title: Update 2.0.7
notes.content:
The production team has been improving the game. This update includes the following contents:

1. In response to player feedback, we have reduced the strength and refresh frequency of the hostile AI, and rewritten the AI logic system. Now AI will intelligently find food and water sources, and will cooperate in combat, etc. Acanthosaurus is added to the game as an AI to expand the ecology.

2. We performed the first round of optimization for the game. Most models can experience a significant frame rate increase, and the frame drop caused by too many corpses has also been improved


3. Adjusted the weather effect, now the weather will change periodically with time

4. Optimized underwater vision and fish Ai
We have a long-term plan for the game. Thank you very much for your support. At the same time, we are still making subversive reforms on the core gameplay and combat system. Many systems, such as incubating eggs and building nests, are under debugging. We will show them as soon as we done it

notes.content:
The second big update will come in a few hours! This big update has the following content altogether, now we publish this announcement

1.Room system: the room system is a new mechanism launched by bo9500 to completely solve the decline of feeling caused by indiscriminate killing, breaking rules and abusing authority. Players can create 4-16 person scale servers, and it is completely free. Players can freely form a team against AI and try to survival. To create a room, you just need to select “Create” at the bottom of the server interface.    
        
2.AI system: at present, we have added four kinds of AI, which are Alamosaurus, Kaidelosaurus, Iguanodon and Tyrannosaurus Rex. The AI of the same species is not equal in size, and the AI of large individuals may be a terrible enemy. In the future, at least five kinds of AI will be added to enrich the ecology, and the distribution of AI in different regions is not the same.        
    
3. Map update: we have adjusted the existing map. While the picture of the new map is upgraded, six islands of different sizes surround the main continent, and each island has a different ecosystem.   
         
4. Tyrannosaurus model replacement: the animation model is remade. In addition to the remake, we also do some rebalance; in addition, two pterosaurs have been greatly weakened, and their attack power is reduced by half, and they can no longer cause bleeding.  
         
5.Repair: now the weather will change itself in the game, and the dinosaurs will move more flexible.

notes.title: UPDATE 2.0 is available！
notes.content:
Major update 6.30.2020            
This update is the first major update since the game was launched. In this update, there are the following contents:            
1.The mechanism of skill tree has been changed. Some dinosaurs have the "final choice", and all branches of the skill tree are one of two choices, which means that even if the survival time is long enough, they can't count all skills.            
2. Three new creatures, Spinosaurus, southern giant dragon and pterodactyl, have been added. They all have unique characteristics and playing methods.            
3. Map changes: the original demo forest is removed and a new map is added.            
4. Change of combat system: different parts of dinosaurs suffer different damage. You need to be careful when fighting!            
5. Optimization: the adjustment of "rendering distance" is added, which is changed from forced 3000m to 1500-3000 optional rendering distance. If FPS is low, this value can be reduced           
 6. Added a novice tutorial, in the start interface there are two language operation tutorial            
7. Fixed bugs in some cases where some organisms get stuck in the water            
8. Cancel the "harsh" sound effect when the state is switched            
9. The existing skills have been modified to cancel the defense setting   
10. the team is max 10 player now.         

Due to the short preparation time of this update, we have completed the content of six months in half a month. There will be a lot of content to be improved in details. We will make urgent modifications after the update is released!
I hope you are happy to feedback bugs and problems!
